title: Why these columns resemble tent poles
position: Main pillared hall of the Akhmenu.
question: Why do these capitals look unlike the Hypostyle Hall?
explanation: The Akhmenu’s unusual central supports are interpreted as monumental versions of tent poles. Compare their profile with open-papyrus capitals in the western hall. Their shape belongs to a different architectural programme; “column” describes a structural role without explaining every form. Avoid claiming that a surviving royal campaign tent has been excavated here.
lookFor: Compare the capital profile and shaft with papyrus-form columns.

claims.text: The central supports represent the poles of a portable tent in the Digital Karnak interpretation.

uncertainties: Exact demonstration photographs and safe on-site viewpoints must be checked before publication.
